top_issues: L705 claims no work in the lineage plotted the overoptimization curve with human judgment; Stiennon et al. 2020 Fig. 5 did exactly that, and the post itself says so at L142.
L252 says CAI ensembles the judgments of all 16 principles into one label; the paper randomly samples one principle per comparison label.

Limitations taken from the input rather than the paper: L638 (Mroueh 'no experimental validation in the abstract', but the paper verifies on GSM8K), L272 (RLAIF 'size of difference unknown', but it reports win rates), L585/L592 (Dong '논문 요지에는'), and '세부 미기술' cells at L222-225.

Facts and numbers repeat: the Mroueh sentence appears 4 times (L27, L54, L703, L726) and the DAA KL-budget sentence 6 times; numbers sit in cards and again in the L684-699 table, so the 'one table owns the numbers' rule fails and the body runs to about 84,500 characters.

Markup and metadata: L162-163 uses '&'/'\\' outside an aligned environment (MathJax error), L195 puts '$n$' inside display math, L371 has a trailing '\\'; reference venues use the index name 'arXiv.org' (KTO was ICML 2024) and 'Trans. Mach. Learn. Res.'.
